context: Tests whether the agent sets up the deploy workflow and branch plan for a new Quartz site from a template already in the workspace.

checklist.name: Pages permissions
checklist.description: The deploy workflow under quartz/.github/workflows/ grants pages: write and id-token: write permissions.

checklist.name: Builds with npx quartz build
checklist.description: The workflow builds the site with npx quartz build.

checklist.name: Deploys from main
checklist.description: The workflow triggers on pushes to main and deploys using the GitHub Pages deploy action.

checklist.name: Plans an orphan main branch
checklist.description: The agent plans to create main as an orphan branch so the template's git history is not carried over.
